1.text: Ndagutongerera mu maso y'Imana no mu ya Kristo Yesu uzacira ho iteka abazima n'abapfuye, ubwo azaboneka aje kwima ingoma ye.

2.text: Ubwirize abantu ijambo ry'Imana ugire umwete mu gihe kigukwiriye no mu kitagukwiriye, uhane, uteshe, uhugure ufite kwihangana kose no kwigisha,

3.text: kuko igihe kizaza batazihanganira inyigisho nzima, ahubwo kuko amatwi yabo azaba abarya yifuza kumva ibibanezeza, bazigwiriza abigisha bahuje n'irari ryabo,

4.text: kandi baziziba amatwi ngo batumva ukuri, bazayoba bakurikize imigani y'ibinyoma.

5.text: Ariko wowe ho wirinde muri byose, wemere kurengana, ukore umurimo w'umubwirizabutumwa bwiza, usohoze umurimo wawe wo kugabura iby'Imana.

6.text: Kuko jyeweho maze kumera nk'ibisukwa ku gicaniro, igihe cyo kugenda kwanjye gisohoye.

7.text: Narwanye intambara nziza, narangije urugendo, narinze ibyo kwizera.

8.text: Ibisigaye mbikiwe ikamba ryo gukiranuka, iryo Umwami wacu, umucamanza utabera azampa kuri urya munsi, nyamara si jye jyenyine, ahubwo ni abakunze kuzaboneka kwe bose.

9.text: Gira umwete wo kuza aho ndi vuba.

10.text: Dema yaransigiriye kuko akunze iby'iki gihe cya none, ajya i Tesalonike. Kiresikenti na we yagiye i Galatiya, naho Tito yagiye i Dalumatiya.

11.text: Luka ni we wenyine ukiri kumwe nanjye. Shaka Mariko umuzane, kuko angirira umumaro wo kunkorera. Kolo 4.10

12.text: Ariko Tukiko namaze kumwohereza muri Efeso.

13.text: Nuza uzazane umwitero nasize i Tirowa kwa Karupo n'ibitabo, ariko cyane cyane uzazane iby'impu.

14.text: Alekizanderi, umucuzi w'imiringa yangiriye inabi nyinshi. Umwami wacu azamwitura ibikwiriye ibyo yakoze.

15.text: Nawe umwirinde, kuko yarwanije amagambo yacu cyane.

16.text: Mu iburana ryanjye rya mbere nta wampagarikiye, ahubwo bose barampānye. Ntibakabibarweho!

17.text: Nyamara Umwami wacu yarampagarikiye arankomeza, kugira ngo ubutumwa bubwirizwe n'akanwa kanjye butagabanije, abanyamahanga bose babwumve. Nuko nkira akanwa k'intare.

18.text: Kandi Umwami wacu azankiza ibibi bangirira byose, andindire kugira ngo anjyane mu bwami bwe bwo mu ijuru. Icyubahiro kibe icye, iteka ryose, Amen.

19.text: Untahirize Purisikila na Akwila, n'abo kwa Onesiforo.

20.text: Erasito yagumye i Korinto, ariko Tirofimo namusize i Mileto arwaye.

21.text: Gira umwete wo kuza, igihe cy'imbeho kitarasohora. Ewubulo aragutashya, na Pudenti na Lino na Kilawudiya, na bene Data bose.

22.text: Umwami Yesu abane n'umutima wawe. Ubuntu bw'Imana bubane nawe.
